issues.description: Query result column 'avg_flaeche' for Aufgabe 05: the problem statement (Aufgabe 05) requires showing the average area of municipalities per Landkreis together with the Landkreis name and its Regierungsbezirk. The solution file solution_repository/aufgabe05.sql (line 1) instead selects "kreis as avg_flaeche", i.e. it assigns the Landkreis name (a string) to the alias avg_flaeche rather than computing a numeric aggregate over the flaeche column. The template file is empty. This inconsistency misrepresents the required numeric aggregate and will confuse students about using AVG() and GROUP BY correctly.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution to compute a numeric average over the area column. Example correction: SELECT regierungsbezirk, kreis, AVG(flaeche) AS avg_flaeche FROM Gemeinde GROUP BY regierungsbezirk, kreis ORDER BY kreis; This ensures avg_flaeche is a numeric aggregation of the flaeche column and matches the problem statement.
